bcod_sim_findings.actuation: Each AzimuthThruster rotates its thrust axis to [cos(azimuth), sin(azimuth), 0] and applies thrust at its configured body-frame lever arm.
bcod_sim_findings.allocation: Desired surge, sway and yaw wrench is allocated across two independently steered pods.

gazebo_stock_model_expected.actuation: Each propeller/thruster joint is a child of an azimuth revolute joint, so joint rotation changes the thrust direction kinematically.
gazebo_stock_model_expected.slew_and_motor_transients: JointPositionController and Thruster dynamics differ from bcod-sim and must be mapped explicitly.

protocol_consequence: The Vehicle C comparison can validly test kinematics, signs, allocation, frame conversion and mapped actuator transients. It cannot test pod interaction physics because neither implementation contains it.
required_preregistration: State the interaction-physics exclusion before trajectories are run.
Compare applied per-pod thrust and applied azimuth angle, not upstream desired wrench alone.
Include straight-ahead, pure-lateral, rotation-in-place and time-varying allocation probes.
Keep allocation/kinematics findings separate from behavioral-dynamics validation.
decision_gate: Vehicle C construction is ready technically, but proceeding treats the scoped Vehicle B negative result as satisfying the original sequencing intent rather than the original literal pass requirement; paper framing should be confirmed by the PI.
